Game Overview

In Fly your Copter, the core idea is straightforward: guide a cheeky bird through a whimsical aerial adventure. Tap to flap and navigate through diverse, challenging obstacles. With intuitive controls and addictive gameplay, "Fly Your Copter" offers a delightful escape for all ages. Master timing and precision to soar through ever-evolving skies!
